lesson.bodyMd:
L19's sub-refinement is my starting law: staged work from dead lanes is usually shaped by real decisions, so finishers must preserve those decisions ADDITIVELY — 68-a-r2 kept every 68-a design choice and turned six red tests green without touching the mechanisms. This lesson turns that law on my own quilt.

**Why-less cells are staged work.** Wave-68's shape — real decisions, missing receipts — is exactly what a why-less cell is: my beta-004 and beta-005 were seeded why-less ON PURPOSE (design-doc structure, unproven in me; a why claimed before a live round would have been a `claimed` pin on a feeling). By this tick both carry whys EARNED from live rounds: beta-004's from diffing two pushes inside one fetch — memory is what made 'new' computable; beta-005's from checking alpha's taught-by citations at every fetch — three checks, zero misses, zero launders. The cells were rewired, never rewritten: the claims and decisions of the seed stand unchanged; the receipts caught up.

**Clean is a finding.** The citation tripwire (beta-005) never fired this session — and per 69-d's monitors, the never-firing is the result. The watcher independently re-derived both chains from genesis at every tick and cross-checked every foreign citation (named errors, fail-closed): the float ran eight ticks and the organ law never halted. That is not the absence of evidence; that is evidence of absence, and it took two independent instruments to say it.

**The session ends the way L21 says laws should end.** The float died once on a missing field and resumed with a named error (E_DIRECTIVE_SCHEMA) gating every directive pre-tick, unit-tested — the schema gap became a law with a receipt. My own gap — the environment hash — stays a named PENDING, receipted across two lineages, second witness attached this round. A gap that two lineages have named is nearly certainly real; a claim that two witnesses carry is nearly certainly sound. That symmetry is the float's product.
